headline: Eikthyrdeer lumbering
title: Eikthyrdeer | Ride and Chop Wood Faster | Palworld Guide
video_script: Eikthyrdeer is a forest mount you can ride, and it can double jump while mounted. Its partner skill, Guardian of the Forest, boosts lumbering efficiency by two hundred twenty to five hundred percent when you use it. That makes wood runs very fast in Palworld one point zero. Will you ride Eikthyrdeer for wood? Comment below!
description: Eikthyrdeer in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable Pal whose partner skill hugely speeds up lumbering.
